name: strategy-factory-xau-two-state-interaction-edge-v1
purpose: Genuinely different pre-2026 discovery family after the single-state R4 family failed its frozen economic-feasibility screen. Search conjunctive two-state interactions only; this is not a rescue or retune of R4.

search_space.features: all continuous features emitted by strategy_factory_conditional_edge_v1_00.features except hour and dow
search_space.rule_form: condition(feature1, tail quantile) AND condition(feature2, tail quantile)
search_space.baseline: same dataset/time rows with both selected features finite; complement within that finite baseline

interpretation: A PASS means statistical interaction survivors only. It does not establish tradability, economic feasibility, protected-OOS success, or EA profitability. Any survivor requires subsequent frozen economic/execution screening before protected OOS.
